name: framework-setup-drift-inspection-and-3a9e
instr:
Goravel cannot inspect package setup drift or safely repair incomplete, customized, or malformed module installations. Extend `packages.Setup(args)` from `github.com/goravel/framework/packages` with inspection and repair, returning structured reports without terminating successful calls.

Preserve recipe declaration order and stable observation identity, status, location, explanation, repairability, and failure. Unchanged state produces an equivalent report. `Report.HasDrift` is false exactly when every observation is satisfied. Inspection is read-only, even under force mode or with missing, malformed, conflicting, legacy, aliased, or differently formatted supported Go structures. Recognize imports, configuration paths, provider lists, and structurally equal syntax nodes in every supported application form.

Repair only declared, safely repairable structure. Preserve sibling and application-owned content, respect conflict policy, and report convergence only when reinspection finds every declaration satisfied. Database observations independently cover its provider, configuration entries, four facades, environment keys, and conditional ownership of generated configuration. Queue, route, cache, mail, validation, and event observations must preserve their distinct providers, configurations, facades, environment entries, registrations, generated resources, migrations, conditional driver state, and ownership boundaries without inventing components.
